correctness.rationale: The signature equation I(i,j)=R_i union B_j yields a rigorous lower bound and forces three differently-row-labelled singleton columns and double columns at equality. Cross-row separation proves every such pattern valid when m>=4. Exhaustive move-type analysis establishes degree 6(m-3) and edge count, and singleton-buffer moves establish connectivity for all m. Deterministic exhaustive subsets m=4..7 and reconstructed exchange graphs m=4..8 independently corroborate finite boundaries but are not substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Identifying-code minimum size measures sensor cost but not the freedom of optimal deployments. A complete natural equality-case classification plus all optimum-preserving one-token exchanges, exact huge solution count, regularity, connectedness, and symmetry orbits answers the meaningful reconfiguration question for an entire canonical Cartesian-product family; neither the scalar optimum nor a routine arithmetic substitution provides this mobility structure.
